column1: # Emoji ID - Hand-maintained Indonesian name overrides
# These override CLDR tts names where the default is unclear or unnatural in Indonesian.
# Faces were reviewed and approved by the developer on 2026-11-03:
# every face name starts with "wajah", and "memberikan ciuman" is shortened to "mencium".
# Music signs are not emoji, so emoji-test.txt does not list them.
# They are kept because Indonesian has its own names for them (CLDR names).
